mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_NUM AS commentNum, C.POST_ID AS postId, C.MEMBER_NUM AS memberNum, C.CONTENT AS content, M.MEMBER_NICK AS author, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT C LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NUM = M.MEMBER_NUM WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NUM ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_COMMENT ( COMMENT_NUM, POST_ID, MEMBER_NUM, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( COMMUNITY_COMMENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{memberNum}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
